metadata.title: Send an announcement | Slashie
metadata.description: Send a Slashie announcement to specific people or cohorts. There is no send-to-everyone.

en.title: Send an announcement
en.description: It lands in each person's Slashie thread in Messages, with a push. Pick people, a cohort, or both, check the recipient count, then send. Nothing here reaches everyone.
en.unavailableBody: This page is for Slashie operators.
en.imageHint: Shown on the announcement card in Messages.
en.targetRequired: Choose at least one person or cohort.

metadata.title: 發送公告 | Slashie
metadata.description: 向指定用戶或群組發送 Slashie 公告。沒有全體發送。

zh_hk.title: 發送公告
zh_hk.description: 公告會出現在每位用戶「訊息」內的 Slashie 對話，並發送推送通知。選擇用戶、群組或兩者，檢查收件人數後再發送。這裡不會發送給所有人。
zh_hk.unavailableBody: 此頁面只供 Slashie 操作人員使用。
zh_hk.imageHint: 會顯示在「訊息」的公告卡片上。
zh_hk.usersHint: 每行一個，或以逗號分隔。
zh_hk.targetRequired: 請至少選擇一個人或一個群組。
